title: Dizzy Gillespie and Charlie Shavers at Bordentown; his age at entry
summary: He mentions that Gillespie and Shavers attended the school, and that he lied about his age to get in at twelve.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Charlie Shavers and Dizzy Gillespie both went to this school. Dizzy was a bad boy; Dizzy got kicked out of school. He hasn't changed a bit either. Dizzy was always dizzy, you know, kind of a devil, always doing nutty things. But anyhow...
How old were you when you started going to this school?
I was 12 years old when I went to this school?
And how old were you when you heard "Black and Tan Fantasy"?

Oh, I was about 10 years old. In fact, I pushed my age up. I wasn't quite 12 when I went to school. That was the minimum. You had to be 12. So I pushed my age up. I lied about it, said that I was a little older. So I got in school. I was always rather tall for my age, although I was very skinny at the time.
